seed_rule: At each run, seed Python random, NumPy and PyTorch with train_seed + rank; DistributedSampler uses train_seed; validation split remains fixed at seed 3.
selection_rule: Within each run, select the highest unrounded single-view F1s among validation checks at epochs 1,3,...,49 (1-based).
primary_comparison: For each seed compare K2 minus B0 best-checkpoint F1s on the same 917 validation images; report all three seed-pair deltas without excluding runs.
minor_damage_endpoint: F1_1, reported for all runs; do not select checkpoints by this endpoint.
